newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says Repsol sale gross proceeds 181 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Spain says Repsol sale gross proceeds 181 bln ptas.

text.p: Spain's state holding company SEPI said on Tuesday the sale of its last 10.0 percent stake in Repsol provided gross revenue of 181.01 billion pesetas versus an expected 120 billion pesetas.
Repsol's last privatisation ended on Monday.
SEPI chairman Pedro Ferreras said net revenues from the sale will total 170.0 billion pesetas, with capital gains of 144.0 billion pesetas.
Ferreras also confirmed that the state will sell between 25 and 35 percent of Endesa around October this year.
Sepi still owns 67 percent of Endesa.
